core_obligations: Display the commutative diagram relating the fibre product D = A times over B with C to A and C, with exact rows (proof lines 339-350).
Choose generators y_1 to y_n of B over C, lift them to x_i in A and show that 1, x_1 to x_n generate A as a D-module (proof lines 350-356).
Observe that D to A times C is injective and that A times C is finite over D, and apply the Artin-Tate lemma to conclude finite generation (proof lines 356-361).
proof_roadmap: Write the exact diagram relating the fibre product to its two factors (proof lines 339-350).
Produce finitely many generators of A over the fibre product (proof lines 350-356).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a fibre product of two finite type algebras over a Noetherian ring is again of finite type under a surjectivity and a finiteness hypothesis, and the proof is a 24-line argument organised around a commutative diagram with exact rows. It chooses module generators of one algebra over the other, lifts them along the surjection, and shows that finitely many elements generate the larger algebra over the fibre product; then it observes that the map from the fibre product into the product of the two algebras is injective and that the target is a finite module over the source, which puts the situation in the range of the Artin-Tate lemma. Both the choice of generators and the finiteness observation are displayed.
